sources.title: MedMCQA: A Large-scale Multi-Subject Multi-Choice Dataset for Medical domain Question Answering
sources.authors: Pal A, Umapathi LK, Sankarasubbu M
sources.content: 194k AIIMS and NEET-PG exam MCQs, 21 subjects, about 2.4k topics; fields id, question, opa-opd, cop, choice_type, exp, subject_name, topic_name
